jobs.occupation: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

• 
Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

• 
Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

• 
Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

• 
Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

• 
Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date. 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

• 
A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

• 
Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

• 
Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

• 
A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

• 
The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

• 
Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

• 
A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

• 
Bring good vibes to the work floor

• 
Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

• 
Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

• 
Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

• 
Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

• 
Have worked in an international workplace.

• 
Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.

A FEW MUST HAVES

• 
You speak fluent Danish and English.

• 
You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

• 
You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

• 
You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

• 
You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

• 
You love to work as we'll need you full time.

jobs.occupation: Passenger car auto mechanic
jobs.description:
Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled auto mechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,600 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

• 
Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems).  

• 
Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

• 
Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors. No work on the high-voltage battery is required.

• 
Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

• 
Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a trained passenger car mechanic

• 
Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

• 
Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

• 
Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

• 
Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

• 
Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

• 
Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

• 
To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

• 
An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

• 
Ongoing training and good development opportunities

• 
A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

• 
Attractive terms of employment

• 
A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

jobs.occupation: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

• 
Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

• 
Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

• 
Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

• 
Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

• 
Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

• 
Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

• 
Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

• 
Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

• 
Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

• 
Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

• 
Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

• 
Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

• 
UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

• 
Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

• 
Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

• 
Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

• 
Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

• 
A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 
A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

• 
Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

• 
Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

• 
Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

• 
Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

• 
Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

• 
EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

• 
EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

• 
Danish language skills

Your competencies

• 
Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

• 
Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

• 
Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

• 
Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

• 
Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com) 

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator
jobs.description:
Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator — MK STUDIO, Glostrup

Hourly paid · 150 DKK/hour · Minimum 32 h/week guaranteed, Mon–Fri · Up to 40 h/week in busy periods · Start October–November 2026

MK STUDIO (mk-ceramics ApS) makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. We're a team of seven across the workshop, office and our Copenhagen shop, selling to cafés, roasters and coffee people across Denmark, the EU and Asia.

• 
Pack 10–15 webshop orders a day, plus wholesale (B2B) orders

• 
Book shipments and print labels in the DHL and UPS apps

• 
Prepare invoices, packing lists and customs documents for shipments outside the EU

• 
Answer all order and customer emails: order status, delays, returns, breakage claims

• 
Handle claims with carriers for damaged or lost parcels

• 
Keep packing materials in stock

Studio and stock (about half your week)

• 
Unload kilns after the glaze firing

• 
Check every piece and sort it: first quality, seconds, reject

• 
Finishing work on fired pieces

• 
Organise the stock room and keep stock numbers correct in our order system

You're the last check before a piece reaches a customer.

What you need

• 
Fluent written and spoken English — you'll talk and write to customers every day

• 
Right to work in Denmark

• 
You can lift and carry up to 20 kg (kiln shelves, boxes) and work on your feet most of the day in a studio with clay dust

Available Monday to Friday, at least 32 hours a week, with extra hours in busy periods, from October–November 2026

• 
Experience with order handling, shipping, warehouse, e-commerce, customer service or similar work

• 
You plan your own day, handle several tasks at once, and flag mistakes early

Good to have

• 
Danish

• 
Driving licence

• 
DHL/UPS bookings and claims

• 
Customs or export paperwork

• 
Experience packing fragile goods (glass, ceramics, wine)

• 
e-conomic, Shopify or spreadsheets

• 
Ceramics or quality-control experience

What we offer

• 
150 DKK/hour, plus holiday pay

• 
32 guaranteed hours a week

• 
3-month trial period

• 
After 6 months, we sit down and negotiate your pay based on your performance and any extra tasks you've taken on

• 
A small team with short lines and fast decisions

Full training in our systems and quality standards

Do you need to work weekends in this job?

Does the job start in January 2027?

jobs.occupation: Senior Embryologist for a Private Fertility Clinic in Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to work as an embryologist at a private fertility clinic in Aarhus, where you will have supportive colleagues, sufficient time to perform your work and a high degree of influence?

We are looking for a skilled embryologist to join our clinic in Aarhus. You will become part of a multidisciplinary team united by a shared passion for making a difference to our patients.

About the position

The clinic is open five to seven days a week throughout the year. Many of our patients come from abroad, although we also treat a considerable number of Danish patients. We offer a full range of treatments within IUI, IVF/ICSI, egg donation and ROPA.

We are a straightforward and informal workplace guided by the principle of freedom with responsibility. Sellmer Klinik Aarhus is owned by Anette Sellmer, who forms the clinic’s management team together with Clinic Manager Bodil Meldgaard. Our management is visible and committed and delegates responsibility to employees who thrive on it.

We place our patients and a positive working environment at the heart of everything we do. This means, among other things, that you will have sufficient time to carry out your duties properly and will be expected to take an active part in developing and implementing new ideas.

he laboratory team performs tasks including:

• 
IVF and ICSI

• 
Embryo transfer

• 
Thawing and cryopreservation of oocytes and blastocysts

• 
AHA

• 
Sperm preparation and cryopreservation

• 
Assessment of oocytes

• 
Administrative duties, including tasks related to the export of tissues and cells

Your colleagues

We have an excellent working environment and work very well together across professional disciplines. We respect and make use of each other’s expertise while keeping up with developments in the field and continuously improving our overall professional standards.

We also have a strong social community. We eat lunch together every day, enjoy spending time together and occasionally meet outside working hours. We value our positive working environment highly and make a genuine effort to protect it. It is therefore important to us that our new colleague feels at home and fits well within the team.

About you

• 
You are a qualified embryologist.

• 
You have experience within fertility treatment.

• 
You enjoy working collaboratively with colleagues on patient-related tasks while also being comfortable working independently.

• 
You speak and write Danish and English.

• 
You are able to work 28–37 hours per week, including weekends and public holidays as part of a fixed rota.

We offer

A workplace with strong collegial support and professional sparring as part of a close multidisciplinary team. You can expect:

• 
Sufficient time to carry out your daily duties and a high degree of influence

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
Friendly and positive colleagues

• 
An organisation with a short path from decision to action

The terms of employment will depend on your experience and qualifications. Employment is conditional upon your consent to the clinic obtaining a satisfactory child protection certificate and upon holding the required professional authorisation.

For further information about the position, please contact Bodil Meldgaard at bodil@sellmerklinik.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
• Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
• Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
• Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
• Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
• Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
• Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
• Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
• Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
• Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications

You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.

You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

• Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
• Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
• Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
• Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
• Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
• Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
• Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
• Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
• Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
• Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.
